page_title: ARS 2-0 LUT | Arsenal v Luton 03/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Ross Barkley (Luton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+3' Jordan Clark (Luton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+1' The linesman signals a throw-in for Luton.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' The corner kick from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

88' A snap shot by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski produces a good save to thwart him. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
87' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
85' That will be all from Emile Smith Rowe who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jorginho (Arsenal).
83' Dangerous play by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Andros Townsend is replaced by Luke Berry (Luton).
80' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
78' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cauley Woodrow (Luton) replaces Fred Onyedinma.
75' Here is a change. Reiss Nelson is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
74' Substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko makes his way off the pitch and Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
74' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Fred Onyedinma (Luton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
73' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner which is cleared.
73' Fred Onyedinma (Luton) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Luton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
72' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Luton.
70' The cross into the penalty area from Carlton Morris (Luton) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
68' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
67' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Thomas Partey will be replaced by Declan Rice (Arsenal).
66' Kai Havertz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
66' This is a yellow card! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
64' Tahith Chong (Luton) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
61' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
60' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Luton.
58' Craig Pawson interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal).
58' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
57' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
55' The ball is out of play. Arsenal will take a throw-in.
54' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu and he is replaced by Tahith Chong (Luton).
53' A cross into the box from Fred Onyedinma (Luton) is cleared. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
52' Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul after Ross Barkley (Luton) hacks down one of his opponents.
51' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Neat passing move from Arsenal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
48' It could have been a good chance to score! Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fails to release Kai Havertz with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
47' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Ross Barkley (Luton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for David Raya to dive and make a save.
45+5' William Saliba (Arsenal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Daiki Hashioka (Luton) scores. Unfortunately for him, it's an own goal!
42' A quickly taken corner by Arsenal.

41' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Kai Havertz (Arsenal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski pulls off a brilliant save.
40' The ball has crossed the sideline. Arsenal are taking a throw-in.
37' Teden Mengi (Luton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' Looks like Teden Mengi (Luton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

34' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Thomas Kaminski is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
33' The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
33' The ball is out of play. Luton will have a throw-in.
32' The Luton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
26' Luton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

24' 1 - 0 Kai Havertz is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 1:0.
23' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Gabriel (Arsenal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
21' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
20' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
15' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
14' The ball is behind the touchline and Arsenal will take a throw-in.
13' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' This shall not pass! Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
8' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner with a short pass.
8' Ben White (Arsenal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Arsenal will take a corner kick.
7' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
4' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carlton Morris (Luton).
3' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Luton will have the kick-off.
